```{r}
load(file.path(result_folder, "DGE_analysis_image.Rdata"))
```

```{r}

ed <- merge(ed, scores, by.x="sampleID", by.y="sampleID", all.x=T, sort=F)

```



```{r}
tmp = read_excel("../../../../Data/ExtData/Zhang_scRNA/All_markers_Epi_with_intestine_BBKNN.xlsx", sheet = 1)

tmp = subset(tmp, p_val_adj < 0.05 & avg_log2FC > 0.5)

sc_sets = split(tmp$gene, tmp$cluster)

```

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
all_ovlp = list()
sel_comparisons = names(all_results)
fc_threshold = 0.5
for (n in sel_comparisons) {
  tmp = all_results[[n]]
  r_up = subset(tmp, padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange > fc_threshold & !(GeneSymbol=="" | GeneSymbol=="NA"))
  r_down = subset(tmp, padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange < -fc_threshold & !(GeneSymbol=="" | GeneSymbol=="NA"))
  
  for (gs in names(sc_sets)) {
    set_genes = sc_sets[[gs]]
    all_ovlp[[paste0(n,"_UP_",gs)]] = intersect(set_genes, r_up$GeneSymbol)  
    all_ovlp[[paste0(n,"_DOWN_",gs)]] = intersect(set_genes, r_down$GeneSymbol)
    
    ll = list()
    ll[[gs]]=set_genes
    ll[[paste0(n,"_UP")]] = r_up$GeneSymbol
    ll[[paste0(n,"_DOWN")]] = r_down$GeneSymbol
    
    p = ggvenn(ll, set_name_size = 4) 
    print(p)
    
  }
}
  
  
```

```{r}
lapply(all_ovlp[grep("Enterocyte a \\(prox\\)|Colonocyte", names(all_ovlp))], sort)
```


# GSVA

```{r}
#input_mat = as.matrix(norm_counts[,grepl("SRR13", colnames(norm_counts))])
#rownames(input_mat) <- norm_counts$GeneSymbol
#res_gsva = gsva(input_mat, sc_sets, kcdf="Gaussian")

input_mat = count_mat
rownames(input_mat) <- gene_anno[rownames(input_mat), "GeneSymbol"]

res_gsva = gsva(input_mat, sc_sets, kcdf="Poisson")
#colnames(res_gsva) = ed[colnames(res_gsva), "Remark"]

col_anno = ed[colnames(input_mat), c("Group", "Site", "Score", "Stomach", "Colon")]
#rownames(col_anno) = paste0("X", rownames(col_anno))
```

```{r, fig.width=12}
anno_cols = list(Group=c("IM"="red","Non-IM"="blue","Control"="green"))
pheatmap(res_gsva, annotation_col = col_anno, labels_col = ed[colnames(res_gsva), "Remark"], annotation_colors = anno_cols)

res_gsva_s1 <- res_gsva[, order(ed[colnames(res_gsva), "Score"])]
pheatmap(res_gsva_s1, annotation_col = col_anno, labels_col = ed[colnames(res_gsva_s1), "Remark"], annotation_colors = anno_cols, cluster_cols=F)

res_gsva_s2 <- res_gsva[, order(ed[colnames(res_gsva), "Colon"])]
pheatmap(res_gsva_s2, annotation_col = col_anno, labels_col = ed[colnames(res_gsva_s2), "Remark"], annotation_colors = anno_cols, cluster_cols=F)


pheatmap(res_gsva[c("Enterocyte c","metaplastic stomach","Enterocyte a (prox)","Colonocyte"),], annotation_col = col_anno, labels_col = ed[colnames(res_gsva), "Remark"], annotation_colors = anno_cols)

```


```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=8, warning=FALSE}
rr_ts <- reshape2::melt(res_gsva)
colnames(rr_ts) <- c("Cluster", "Sample", "GSVA_Score")
rr_ts$Sample <- gsub("^X","", rr_ts$Sample)
rr_ts <- merge(rr_ts, ed, by.x="Sample", by.y="sampleID", all.x=T)
rr_ts$Condition <- ifelse(grepl("^SI", rr_ts$Patient), "SI", ifelse(grepl("^HGAT", rr_ts$Patient), "Normal stomach", rr_ts$Group))

#rr_ts$Patient <- ifelse(rr_ts$Site=="Antrum", "Normal Antrum", ifelse(rr_ts$Condition %in% c("Colon", "Duodenum"), "Intestine", rr_ts$Patient))

ggplot(rr_ts, aes(x=Condition, y = GSVA_Score)) + 
  geom_point(aes(col = Condition)) + 
  facet_wrap(~Cluster) + 
  geom_hline(yintercept=0, lty=2) + 
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45, hjust=1)) + 
  stat_summary()

ggplot(rr_ts, aes(x=Condition, y = GSVA_Score)) + 
  geom_point(aes(col = Condition)) + 
  facet_wrap(~Cluster) + 
  geom_hline(yintercept=0, lty=2) + 
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45, hjust=1)) + 
  geom_violin(aes(fill=Condition)) + 
  stat_summary(fun = "mean")


# 
# ggplot(subset(rr_ts, !Sample %in% c("4039_Y","4446_P","4446_Q","4446_R","4446_S")), aes(x=Condition, fill=Patient, y = Score)) + geom_boxplot() + facet_wrap(~Cluster) + geom_hline(yintercept=0, lty=2) + theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45, hjust=1)) + ggtitle("Only good normal stomach samples")
```

# Spearman Correlation of Colon vs. Stomach score with signature estimates

```{r}
cor(ed[colnames(res_gsva), "Score"], t(res_gsva), method="spearman") |> (\(x) {x[, order(x[1,]),drop=F]})()
```

```{r}

```
